_comment: What the accessibility ratchet in frontend/tests/e2e/a11y.spec.ts lets through (ADR-0039).
A violation whose (route, rule) pair is listed here passes; anything else fails the build.
Serious and critical violations fail even when listed, unless the entry names that exact
impact in `waiveSeverity` — so a rule that was moderate when it was recorded and has since
become critical still turns the build red.
Every entry carries the task that owns the fix. This file is empty by the end of Phase 2;
an entry with no owner, or an owner that is not a task in the accessibility workstream, is a
violation somebody decided to stop looking at.
The measurements come from docs/verification/a11y.json, regenerated by `make test-a11y`.
_reflowComment: The same ratchet, applied to the horizontal-overflow assertion in
frontend/scripts/screenshots.mjs — WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow and 1.4.4 Resize text, measured by
`make shots`. `page` is the label in that script's PAGES list and `view` its width label.
A pair listed here is reported and allowed; anything else fails. A pair that has stopped
overflowing also fails, so a fixed bug cannot go on looking like a bug.

reflow.reason: The per-endpoint parameter tables on /app/docs push the page 3px sideways at 320 CSS px. Same tables as the scrollable-region-focusable entry below.

entries.reason: The USWDS mobile nav keeps its light-theme link colour in dark mode — #565c65 on #1c1d1f is 2.5:1 against a required 4.5:1. Only at 320px and 375px, where the nav collapses into the panel; 1280px dark is clean.

Two causes on the section pages: the dark mobile nav above, and the copy column's controls, which keep the USWDS primary blue in dark mode — .copycol__whole is #005ea2 on #16150f, 2.71:1. The copy column fails at 1280px dark as well as at the narrow widths.
The dark mobile nav above, plus the zero-result panel's link back to the citation box, which fails at 1280px dark too.

The syntax-highlighting token in this chapter's code blocks is #e1e4e8 on #f0f0f0 — 1.11:1, effectively invisible. Unlike every other contrast entry here it fails in light, in dark, and under forced-colors.
The endpoint method badges are #f0f0f0 on #2e7d32 — 4.49:1 against a required 4.5:1. A hairline miss, failing at every viewport, in both themes, and under forced-colors.

Swagger UI's and ReDoc's own palettes, in the 2.4 MB of vendored assets ADR-0032 commits. Not fixable without forking or restyling the vendor bundle, so it is a published exception rather than a repair.

Horizontally scrollable regions with no keyboard route into them: the per-endpoint parameter tables on /app/docs at 320px and 375px, and the source-XML redline pane on /app/diff. A keyboard user cannot scroll either.

The citation preview card carries aria-hidden="true" and tabindex="0" at the same time, so while it is open it is in the tab order and hidden from assistive technology at once. Found by the preview-focus state, which is why the states are in the matrix.
Swagger UI nests controls inside its operation summaries. Vendored (ADR-0032); a published exception rather than a repair.
The <html> element on /docs and /redoc has no lang attribute. This one is ours rather than the vendor's — the shells come from get_swagger_ui_html and get_redoc_html in main.py.
ReDoc's response-schema picker is a <select> with no accessible name. Vendored (ADR-0032); a published exception rather than a repair.
